extracted.intended_audience: TV viewers and cord-cutters looking to livestream the May 9 SNL episode (Matt Damon/Noah Kahan)
extracted.subtask_description: A one-off consumer guide describing how to livestream the May 9 SNL episode (host Matt Damon, musical guest Noah Kahan), listing which streaming services carry NBC, free trial options, and pricing/plan details to watch for free or at low cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streaming service must carry NBC
rubrics_metrics.description: Since SNL is broadcast on NBC, cord-cutters can stream it live via services that include NBC: DirecTV (with a five-day free trial), Sling, or Hulu + Live TV; it will also livestream on Peacock (which does not offer a free trial).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose any streaming service that carries NBC to watch the live broadcast; examples given are DirecTV, Sling, Hulu + Live TV, and Peacock. Note that Peacock is the official streaming home but does not offer a direct free trial.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use DirecTV five-day free trial to watch live
rubrics_metrics.description: NBC is included in any of DirecTV’s signature packages: Entertainment, Choice, Ultimate or Premier. DirecTV is offering a five-day free trial for its streaming service, meaning new subscribers can catch Saturday’s episode at no cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DirecTV packages start from $19.99 per month; use the five-day free trial (new subscribers) to stream the episode without paying. Learn plan options including how to build your own channel lineup at directv.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peacock is official streaming home — consider pricing and partner access
rubrics_metrics.description: Peacock is the official streaming home of SNL. The streamer does not offer a free trial directly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peacock Premium (ad-supported) is $10.99/month or $109.99/year; Peacock Premium Plus (ad-free) is $16.99/month or $169.99/year. However, free Peacock access is possible through partner subscriptions (Instacart+ and Walmart+), which include Peacock Premium and offer their own free trials (Instacart+ 14 days; Walmart+ 30 days).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sling options: NBC in Blue Plan; Orange & Blue recommended
rubrics_metrics.description: NBC is included in Sling’s Blue Plan, starting at $45.99 per month.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For best coverage, opt for Sling’s Orange & Blue plan (everything both Orange and Blue have to offer), starting at $60.99/month. Sling is also advertising promotions such as half off the first month for select plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hulu + Live TV three-day free trial and bundle details
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV offers a three-day free trial and includes NBC in its channel lineup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hulu + Live TV packages start from $89.99/month and come bundled with Disney+ and ESPN+. Use the three-day free trial (new subscribers) to watch the live NBC broadcast for free during the trial window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check air date and local airtime
rubrics_metrics.description: The Matt Damon–hosted episode airs live on May 9, at 8:30 p.m. PT/11:30 p.m. ET on NBC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make sure to tune in at the scheduled local airtime and confirm the stream is set to the correct time zone; plan signups around the free trial windows so they cover the episode time.
